## Introduction
*The usage panel and the quota capsule, as they ship on the web client.*

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
plugin that serves **OpenCode Go** (`https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`) as a n

ative
DSH model provider.

The plugin implements OpenCode Go's three wire formats itself: it translates
harness messages, tools

, and reasoning into each protocol's request, and

## Features

| **Provider route** | `opencode-go` (configurable) |
| **Protocols** | OpenAI Responses, OpenAI-com

patible Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages |
| **Model discovery** | `GET /models`: each model's n
ame, description, limits, modalities, reasoning ladder and preferred protocol, cached in memory and

on disk |
| **Session affinity** | `x-opencode-session`, one stable id per conversation |
| **Tool c
alling** | Full round trip for every dispatched call: definitions, fragmented arguments, tool result

s, follow-up turn |
| **Reasoning** | Per-model effort ladders from the service, per-protocol transl

ation, including Anthropic thinking budgets |
| **Streaming** | SSE → `StreamChunk`, with usage, fin

ish reason, and an idle watchdog |
| **Failures** | Stable provider-neutral codes (`AUTH`, `RATE_LIM

IT`, `QUOTA`, `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`, `MODEL_DEPRECATED`, `MODEL_UNAVAILABLE`, …) |
| **Configura
tion UI** | One page in the web client, with a row in Settings' own navigation and a Configure contr
ol on the plugin's row: API key, credential reference, model visibility and variants, fetching the m

odel list, usage |
| **Fast entries** | A quota capsule at the sidebar's foot (one ring per window —
`5H / Wk / Mo` — with what is left of each), a usage panel of its own (from that row, or the keyboa

rd), and a usage page under Settings |
| **Runtime** | Node.js ≥ 20; no runtime dependencies |
